title: Steady leisure without perfect fullness

captions.energy: Completing leisure towards a finished ideal
captions.emotions: Feeling support in a clear order

meaning: A clear measure supports leisure when open participation and stability leave every pleasant possibility free from requiring ideal completeness.
text: Clear leisure can acquire an excessive requirement of fullness. The Sun in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes open participation and exchanging pleasant experience. The World in energy leans towards completing leisure as a finished ideal. The Emperor in emotions offers support in clear order. Both may enjoy agreement about time and form. Yet this easily becomes using every prepared possibility compulsorily. Stability then supports proving the evening wholly correct, with nothing unfinished, rather than freely enjoying the time available together.

For example, you agree to view beautiful illustrations and enjoy discussing the first ones. Pages remain when the chosen time ends. **A clear measure can finish leisure before everything is covered.** You can leave the album for later without feeling order was broken. Agreement already helped company. It need not require every page to be viewed before both recognise a sufficient pleasant experience and calmly choose what follows.

The difficulty is adding compulsory completion to simple support. You extend viewing while living interest fades and turn pleasure into fulfilling a plan. Order helps when allowing an actual response. Both can agree an ending through available time and desire. Stability remains when unfinished pages are a free possibility instead of evidence of an imperfect shared evening. The experience already received can be settled without closing everything still available.
